{{Quote|Mandalore. Turn right off the Hydian Way. You can't miss it.|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>}}
The '''Hydian Way''' {{Pronounced|'haɪ.di.ən}}<ref name="Timeline3">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 3: The Return of the Mandalorians|int=Timeline 3: The Return of the Mandalorians}}</ref> was a [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] that began at the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] on one side of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and continued through the core to the other side, past [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. It was the only route that passed through the entire galaxy. The Hydian Way was blazed around [[3700 BBY/Legends|3700 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> by famed [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] native [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]],<ref name="IDC">''[[Imperial Double-Cross]]''</ref> and helped open up much of the galaxy beyond the region known as [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]], fundamentally altering the scale of galactic civilization. The route was named in honor of [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]], and later Kallea's colleague, [[Banu Hydia]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Astrography==
Beginning at the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]], the Hydian Way led past [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]] and [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Just after intersection with the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] at Brentaal, one of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] was connected near [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]]. The Hydian Way then went by [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili]], to cross the Corellian Run again, this time at Inner Rim world [[Denon/Legends|Denon]]. It continued near [[Derra IV/Legends|Derra IV]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] and [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], crossing [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] at Eriadu, and ended in the Outer Rim, close to [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]] and [[Subterrel/Legends|Subterrel]].

==History==
In [[3705 BBY/Legends|3705 BBY]], Freia Kallea made the first pushes into space with her scoutship, [[Hope (scoutship)|''Hope'']], funded with the help of her secret lover [[Sival Brentioch]]. She accepted the commission that was described "as far as [[Farana/Legends|Farana]]," creating a path through the [[Crombach Nebula/Legends|Crombach Nebula]], as well as discovering a reliable route between the worlds of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] and [[Telos IV]], finishing the next year in [[3704 BBY]]. Her actions forced [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] scouts [[Thoax Osaax|Thoax]] and [[Farge Osaax]] to hire [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Banu Hydia]] to eliminate her, but he refused, instead discussing her plans to expand rimward south of [[Denon/Legends|Denon]]. Hydia's warnings about the treacherous [[Tyus Cluster/Legends|Tyus Cluster]] and the dangerous [[Itani Nebula/Legends|Itani Nebula]] were ignored, however, she continued to make news across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by charting an extension of the new route from Denon to [[Demos Four]] from [[3703 BBY]] to [[3702 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

Upon reaching [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], Kallea was arrested by thugs of Thoax and Farge and was subsequently freed by Hydia. She later returned to Malastare determined to complete her route, however, her scoutship was crippled by the Neimoidians, forcing her to crash land on the nearby world of [[Nuvar]]. With Kallea out of the way, the Neimoidians charted the [[Seswenna Expansion]] for themselves, from [[3701 BBY]] to [[3699 BBY]], reaching the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] south of [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. Kallea remained on Nuvar for six standard years until she was finally located by Hydia in [[3694 BBY]]. After returning to civilization, she reengaged in scouting to finish her work, requesting that Hydia join her on the last leg of their journey, to which he accepted. Kallea and Hydia pushed through the dust clouds of the [[Tosste system/Legends|Tosste system]] and came across the hub of [[Terminus/Legends|Terminus]]. There would be one last push that would finalize their route, the [[Hydian Spur]], with a trap set up on the world of treasure-rich planet of [[Imynusoph/Legends|Imynusoph]] to capture the Neimoidians. After a battle with the Neimoidians' henchmen, the opposition was arrested by the local [[Imyni/Legends|Imyni]]; however, Hydia became mortally wounded and died. In his honor, Freia Kallea named her route the Hydian Way.<ref name="TEA" />

Existing hyperspace routes that were sewn together by Kallea into the Hydian Way included the [[Morellian Trail]], the [[Spurs of Celanon/Legends|Spurs of Celanon]], the [[Sprizen End Run]], the [[Mandalorian Road]], the [[Corsin Run]], the [[Brentaal–Denon Route]], and the [[Dustig Trace]].
The Dustig Trace was absorbed into the Hydian Way in [[3693 BBY]], bolstering Malastare into a trading hub. Some historians argued that her discovery was merely an extension of what had already been established, but many scouts continued to admire her accomplishments.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Mandalorian_Blockade.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Mandalorians set up a blockade on the Hydian Way.]]
In [[3661 BBY]] (7 BTC), [[Mandalorian cruiser]]s seized control of the Hydian Way<ref name="Timeline3" /> and set up a [[Blockade of the Hydian Way|blockade]], choking the Republic and placing it in an economic crisis. A [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] named [[Hylo Visz]] saw this as an opportunity for profit and gathered together several smugglers for an assault on the Mandalorians. She commanded a fleet of ships to stop one [[Parsec/Legends|parsec]] outside of the blockade, and while the Mandalorians were distracted, her fleet jumped out of hyperspace to attack. Initially they were outnumbered but the Republic caught word of the assault and sent reinforcements. This extra push by the Republic was enough to break up the Mandalorian blockade, effectively freeing the galaxy from starvation and civil war. Visz was considered a hero of the Republic, but was nowhere to be seen upon her medal ceremony.<ref name="Timeline2">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken|int=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] hired by the Empire deployed a [[Mine/Legends|minefield]] to blockade the Hydian Way and redirect Republic convoys into an ambush.<ref name="Hydian Way Blokade">{{TORcite|type=space|Hydian Way Blockade}}</ref>

Over the centuries, [[Eriadu Way]], originally a separate hyperlane, eventually became considered part of the Hydian Way. In addition, as the galaxy rotated, some sections of the original Hydian Way had shifted.<ref name="TEA" />

Twenty-two hundred years after the charting of the Hydian Way, the events that created it were documented in the [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaalan]] opera ''[[The Kallea Cycle]]''.<ref name="TEA" />

[[Cardan-class space station|''Cardan''-class space stations]] were present at the crossroads between the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] and the Hydian Way.

==Behind the scenes==
Freia Kallea's discovery of the Hydian Way originally took place around [[3000 BBY]], as established in sources such as ''[[Imperial Double-Cross]]'', but was later [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] to take place before the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="DW">{{Blog|danwallace|146|Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 4 of 5)}}</ref>
